citations.claim: NS green at step 103, last green before truncated yellow
NS still yellow at step 107, only 4th yellow second
NS red at step 108, first violating step: yellow lasted 4s vs required 6s

counterfactual.change: Removed the single 1s emergency event at t=31 on N; otherwise identical (same steps, rates, timings). Passing scenario shows the truncated NS yellow depends on the earlier emergency preemption.

explanation: A 1s emergency on N at t=31 preempts EW green, forcing EW into yellow at step 31 (seen EW yellow at step 31, all-red at 37). That preemption corrupts or fails to reset the shared yellow timer, so the next NS yellow (steps 104-107) is cut short to 4s instead of yellow_seconds=6, turning red at step 108. Removing only the emergency event removes the violation.
vision_note: Frames 105 to 107 show yellow lights for the NS approaches while the EW approaches remain red. At frame 108 the NS yellows have turned red after only about four seconds, cutting the required 6s yellow short.
